ur_wahiduddin: جس نے جھٹلایا اور روگردانی کی

en_qarai: The Godwary [person] will be spared of that
en_ahmedali: But save him who fears

fa_khorramdel: ولیکن پرهیزگارترین (انسانها) از آن (آتش هولناک) به دور داشته خواهد شد
de_aburida: Geschont von ihm wird derjenige sein, der gottesfürchtig ist
de_bubenheim: Doch davon ferngehalten wird der Gottesfürchtigste werden
de_khoury: Ferngehalten davon wird der Gottesfürchtigste werden
de_zaidan: Und es wird von ihm der Muttaqi ferngehalten
ur_taqiusmani: اور اس سے ایسے پرہیزگار شخص کو دور رکھا جائے گا۔

urdu_jawadi: جو اپنے مال کو دے کر پاکیزگی کا اہتمام کرتا ہے
en_pickthall: Who giveth his wealth that he may grow (in goodness).
en_sahih: [He] who gives [from] his wealth to purify himself
en_khattab: who donate ˹some of˺ their wealth only to purify themselves
en_usmani: who gives his wealth (in charity) to become purified,
en_abdelhaleem: who gives his wealth away as self-purification,

en_yusufali: Those who spend their wealth for increase in self-purification,
en_qarai: —he who gives his wealth to purify himself
en_ahmedali: And gives of his wealth that he may grow in virtue,

en_wahiduddin: one who gives his wealth to become purified,

en_itani: He who gives his money to become pure.
en_mubarakpuri: He who gives of his wealth for self-purification.

ur_jalandhry: جو مال دیتا ہے تاکہ پاک ہو

en_usmani: while no one has conferred any favour on him for which he would give a return,
en_abdelhaleem: not to return a favour to anyone
en_asad: not as payment for favours received,
en_yusufali: And have in their minds no favour from anyone for which a reward is expected in return,
